text.en: Fold a sheet in half, sprinkle water colours in the centre of the fold, press and open. Is it symmetrical?

We have already seen symmetry in rangolis, masks, bead strings and buildings.
Ink design: fold paper in half, sprinkle water colours in the centre of the fold and press. Open it and look.
The pattern has two matching halves. The fold line is the line of symmetry.
A shape may have one or more lines of symmetry. A square has 4 and a rectangle has 2.
Letters like A, H and M have lines of symmetry.
